name: comp-156
blurb: Radio option that expands to reveal an input field when selected.
description: Radio group with two options. First option reveals a text input when selected, which auto-focuses and disables when not selected. Uses CSS grid for smooth height animation.
use_when: Forms where additional input is only needed for one radio option.
avoid_when: Simple forms—this adds complexity for edge cases.
a11y: Radio controls the input via aria-controls. Input has aria-label. Region role marks expandable area. Full keyboard support.
